name: Diagnostic - Model
description: Model code. A Series F4P reads 5280 (the manual labels it "4P"); identify requires this value.

name: Diagnostic - Serial Number (first part)
description: Serial number, first part. The manual gives the serial as a six-digit number (000000 to 999999) split across registers 1 and 2; identify joins them as first * 10000 + second.

name: Diagnostic - Serial Number (second part)
description: Serial number, second part (low four digits).

name: Diagnostic - Software Number
description: Software identification number.

name: Diagnostic - Revision
description: Software revision in hundredths (manual: 0.00 to 9.99, raw 0 to 999). The IR-301's custom build reads 2400 (24.00), beyond the documented range.

name: Diagnostic - Manufacturing Date
description: Manufacture date as WWYY (week, two-digit year); the bench unit reads 4110 (week 41 of 2010).

name: Diagnostic - Input 1
description: Input 1 hardware: None (0), Universal single (7), Universal (8). The bench unit reads 7.

name: Diagnostic - Output 1A
description: Output 1A hardware: None (0), Mechanical Relay (1), SSR (2), DC / open collector (3), Process (4).
range: None (0), Mechanical Relay (1), SSR (2), DC (3), Process (4)

name: Status - Input 1 Value
description: Input 1 process value in the system temperature unit (register 901). Implied decimal places follow register 606.

name: Status - Input 1 Error
description: Input 1 error: None (0), A/D Underflow (1), Sensor Under Range (2), Sensor Over Range (3), A/D Overflow (4), A/D Timeout (5), Open Loop (6).
range: None (0), A/D Underflow (1), Sensor Under Range (2), Sensor Over Range (3), A/D Overflow (4), A/D Timeout (5), Open Loop (6)

name: Status - Alarm 1
description: Alarm 1 state: Off (0), Alarm High (1), Alarm Low (2).

name: Status - % Power Output 1A
description: Output 1A power, percent, raw tenths. The manual gives no scale; tenths is inferred from live readings (130 while recovering, 117 at set point) and from the high power limit (register 714) reading 450 for a 45.0 % cap. Not yet checked against the front-panel % Power display.

name: Status - Cold Junction Sensor Value
description: Cold-junction temperature per the ISDC IR-301 manual (not in the F4P manual's register table), raw tenths in the system unit (register 901). Bench unit: 217 (21.7 C) with 901 = C while register 1500 read 711 (71.1 F), so scale and unit agree.

name: Status - Cold Junction Error
description: Cold-junction error status per the ISDC IR-301 manual (not in the F4P manual's register table). Codes undocumented; 0 observed with no error.

name: Status - Alarm 2
description: Alarm 2 state: Off (0), Alarm High (1), Alarm Low (2).

name: Status - % Power Output 1B
description: Output 1B power, percent. Same inferred tenths scale as register 103; unconfirmed. Units without output 1B report 0.

name: Status - Auto/Manual Mode
description: Control mode: Auto (1), Manual (2). Note the F4P codes differ from the Series SD (Auto 0, Manual 1).

name: Status - Digital Input 1
description: Digital input 1 level: Low (0), High (1).

name: Status - System Error
description: System error status per the ISDC IR-301 manual (not in the F4P manual's register table). Codes undocumented; 0 observed with no error.

name: Status - Input 1 Open Loop
description: Open-loop detection on input 1: Off (0), On (1).

name: Status - Control Set Point
description: The set point the loop is currently controlling to (after ramping and remote/local selection). Implied decimal places follow register 606.

name: Main Page - Set Point 1
description: Set point 1. Implied decimal places follow register 606. Writable on the device (r/w) but exposed read-only here; writes are out of scope until the blackbody owner authorises them.
range: Set Point Low Limit to Set Point High Limit

name: Alarm Set Points - Alarm 1 Low
description: Alarm 1 low threshold. Meaning follows Alarm Type (register 702): process set point, deviation from set point, or maximum rate. Implied decimal places follow register 606. Device r/w; read-only here.

name: Alarm Set Points - Alarm 1 High
description: Alarm 1 high threshold. Meaning follows Alarm Type (register 702). Implied decimal places follow register 606. Device r/w; read-only here.

name: Alarm Set Points - Alarm 2 Low
description: Alarm 2 low threshold. Meaning follows Alarm Type (register 719). Implied decimal places follow register 606. Device r/w; read-only here.

name: Alarm Set Points - Alarm 2 High
description: Alarm 2 high threshold. Meaning follows Alarm Type (register 719). Implied decimal places follow register 606. Device r/w; read-only here.

name: PID Set 1 - Proportional Band 1A
description: Proportional band for output 1A, PID set 1, in input units. Implied decimal places follow register 606. Device r/w; read-only here.

name: PID Set 1 - Integral 1A
description: Integral time for output 1A, PID set 1, minutes per repeat (raw hundredths). Shown when PID Units (register 900) is SI. Device r/w; read-only here.

name: PID Set 1 - Reset 1A
description: Reset for output 1A, PID set 1, repeats per minute (raw hundredths). Shown when PID Units (register 900) is US. Device r/w; read-only here.

name: PID Set 1 - Derivative 1A
description: Derivative time for output 1A, PID set 1, minutes (raw hundredths). Device r/w; read-only here.

name: PID Set 1 - Rate 1A
description: Rate for output 1A, PID set 1, minutes (raw hundredths). Device r/w; read-only here.

name: PID Set 1 - Dead Band 1A
description: Dead band for output 1A, PID set 1, in input units. Implied decimal places follow register 606. Device r/w; read-only here.

name: PID Set 1 - Hysteresis 1A
description: On-off hysteresis for output 1A, PID set 1, in input units. Implied decimal places follow register 606. Device r/w; read-only here.

name: Analog Input 1 - Sensor
description: Input 1 sensor class: Thermocouple (0), RTD (1), Process (2). Device r/w; read-only here.

name: Analog Input 1 - Sensor Type
description: Input 1 sensor type: J (0), K (1), T (2), E (3), N (4), C (5), D (6), PT2 (7), R (8), S (9), B (10), DIN 100 ohm RTD (11), JIS 100 ohm RTD (12), 4-20 mA (13), 0-20 mA (14), 0-5 V (15), 1-5 V (16), 0-10 V (17), 0-50 mV (18), DIN 500 ohm RTD (23), JIS 500 ohm RTD (24), DIN 1 kohm RTD (25), JIS 1 kohm RTD (26). Device r/w; read-only here.

name: Analog Input 1 - Set Point Low Limit
description: Lowest set point the device accepts for input 1. Implied decimal places follow register 606. Device r/w; read-only here.

name: Analog Input 1 - Set Point High Limit
description: Highest set point the device accepts for input 1. Implied decimal places follow register 606. Device r/w; read-only here.

name: Analog Input 1 - Filter Time
description: Input 1 filter time in seconds (raw tenths); negative values filter the display only. Device r/w; read-only here.

name: Analog Input 1 - Calibration Offset
description: Offset added to input 1. Implied decimal places follow register 606. Device r/w; read-only here.
range: Set Point Low Limit to Set Point High Limit

name: Analog Input 1 - Decimal
description: Decimal places for input 1 values and the registers derived from them: 0 (0), 0.0 (1), 0.00 (2, process only), 0.000 (3, process only). identify reads this and rescales every row bound to register 606. The bench IR-301 reads 1. Device r/w; read-only here.

name: Analog Input 1 - Error Latch
description: Input 1 error latching: Self Clear (0), Latch (1). Device r/w; read-only here.

name: Analog Input 1 - Units
description: Whether input 1 is a temperature or a process value with custom units: Temperature (0), Units (1). Device r/w; read-only here.

name: Control Output 1A - Function
description: Output 1A function: Off (0), Heat (1, reverse acting), Cool (2, direct acting). Device r/w; read-only here.

name: Alarm Output 1 - Alarm Type
description: Alarm 1 type: Off (0), Process (1), Deviation (2), Maximum Rate (3). Decides how registers 302 and 303 are interpreted. Device r/w; read-only here.

name: Alarm Output 1 - Alarm Hysteresis
description: Alarm 1 hysteresis in input units. Implied decimal places follow register 606. Device r/w; read-only here.

name: Alarm Output 1 - Latching
description: Alarm 1 latching: Self-clears (0), Latches (1). Device r/w; read-only here.

name: Alarm Output 1 - Silencing
description: Alarm 1 silencing allowed: No (0), Yes (1). Device r/w; read-only here.

name: Alarm Output 1 - Alarm Sides
description: Alarm 1 active sides: Both (0), Low (1), High (2). Device r/w; read-only here.

name: Alarm Output 1 - Alarm Logic
description: Alarm 1 output logic: Open on Alarm (0), Close on Alarm (1). Device r/w; read-only here.
range: Open on Alarm (0), Close on Alarm (1)

name: Control Output 1A - High Power Limit
description: Upper limit on output 1A power, percent, raw tenths (the bench unit reads 450 for a 45.0 % cap; the manual prints the range in whole percent). Device r/w; read-only here.

name: Control Output 1A - Low Power Limit
description: Lower limit on output 1A power, percent, raw tenths like register 714. Device r/w; read-only here.

name: Alarm Output 1 - Alarm Source
description: Input alarm 1 watches: Input 1 (0), Input 2 (1), Input 3 (2). Device r/w; read-only here.

name: Alarm Output 2 - Alarm Type
description: Alarm 2 type: Off (0), Process (1), Deviation (2), Maximum Rate (3). Decides how registers 321 and 322 are interpreted. Device r/w; read-only here.

name: Alarm Output 2 - Alarm Hysteresis
description: Alarm 2 hysteresis in input units. Implied decimal places follow register 606. Device r/w; read-only here.

name: Alarm Output 2 - Latching
description: Alarm 2 latching: Self-clears (0), Latches (1). Device r/w; read-only here.

name: Alarm Output 2 - Silencing
description: Alarm 2 silencing allowed: No (0), Yes (1). Device r/w; read-only here.

name: Alarm Output 2 - Alarm Sides
description: Alarm 2 active sides: Both (0), Low (1), High (2). Device r/w; read-only here.

name: Alarm Output 2 - Alarm Logic
description: Alarm 2 output logic: Open on Alarm (0), Close on Alarm (1). Device r/w; read-only here.
range: Open on Alarm (0), Close on Alarm (1)

name: Alarm Output 2 - Alarm Source
description: Input alarm 2 watches: Input 1 (0), Input 2 (1), Input 3 (2). Device r/w; read-only here.

name: System - Failure Mode
description: Output behaviour on input failure: Bumpless Transfer (0), Fixed (1). Device r/w; read-only here.

name: System - PID Units
description: PID parameter convention: US reset/rate (0), SI integral/derivative (1). Device r/w; read-only here.

name: System - Temperature Units
description: System temperature unit for the display and every temperature register: F (0), C (1). identify reads this to set the session's wire temperature unit. The bench IR-301 reads 1. Device r/w; read-only here.

name: System - Input 1 Failure Power
description: Fixed output power applied when input 1 fails and Failure Mode (register 880) is Fixed, percent, raw tenths by analogy with register 714 (bench unit reads 0; unconfirmed). Device r/w; read-only here.

name: System - Open Loop Detect
description: Open-loop detection: Off (0), On (1). Device r/w; read-only here.

name: Operations - Ramp to Set Point Mode
description: Set point ramping: Off (0), Startup (1), Startup or Change (2). Device r/w; read-only here.

name: Operations - Ramp to Set Point Rate
description: Set point ramp rate, degrees or units per minute or hour (register 1102 picks the scale). Device r/w; read-only here.

name: Ramp to Set Point - Scale
description: Ramp rate time base: Degrees per Minute (0), Degrees per Hour (1). Device r/w; read-only here.
range: Degrees per Minute (0), Degrees per Hour (1)

name: Diagnostic - CJC1 Temp
description: Cold-junction compensation temperature for input 1, raw tenths (manual: xx.x). Reads in degrees F on the bench unit even with register 901 set to C (711 = 71.1 F while register 104 read 21.7 C), so it is left untagged; register 104 carries the system-unit value.

name: Diagnostic - Line Frequency
description: Measured mains frequency, Hz.

name: System - Show F or C
description: Whether the upper display shows the temperature-unit indicator: No (0), Yes (1). The ISDC IR-301 manual lists this register as the unit itself; the F4P manual defines it as the display toggle only. The unit is register 901. Device r/w; read-only here.
